FreshRetailNet aggregate goes from -0.506% (RAW) to -0.809% (SAFE); all three scale variants agree it is negative. RQ2 is answered no.
Removing the pre-identified collapse fold drops SAFE from +62.488% to +4.802% and RAW from +67.924% to +9.680%. The direction survives, the magnitude does not.
Each dataset gives 2-3 calibrated folds after the cold start, so the lambda-instability WARN (range > 0.8 with >= 3 folds) can only fire on M5 and Favorita.
